newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss conveyor maker Interroll plans IPO.
newsitem.headline: Swiss conveyor maker Interroll plans IPO.

text.p: Interroll Holding AG, which makes conveyor belt and rolling transport systems for the world market, said it planned an initial public share offering in the near future.
"The Interroll Group...plans to float its shares in Switzerland in the near future depending on further developments on the bourse," it said in a statement. It did not elaborate on the timing.
Interroll said it was the world's leading provider of conveyor belt systems and hi-tech components. Founded in 1959, it is based in San Atonino in the southern Swiss canton of Ticino, near Italy.

Interroll said it posted a 1996 net profit of 7.2 million Swiss francs on sales of 171 million, with the biggest sales markets in Germany and the United States. Cashflow was 15.4 million Swiss francs and the workforce totalled 1,100.

Its products include conveyor belts and automated rollways for such uses as airports, the food industry or computer production as well as heavier bulk transport belts for used in mines, construction, recyling and the chemical industry.
